hypothesis: Aggregated indicators lose the ordering and shape of recent price movement. Preserve the last 32 completed M5 bars as a direction-normalized raw path and train separate direction-regime specialist models.

time_and_sequence.lag_zero: the M5 bar that has just closed at decision_time
time_and_sequence.gap_rule: A sequence is valid only when all 32 decision timestamps are exactly five minutes apart. No sequence crosses a weekend, data gap or missing bar.

direction_normalization.LONG: direction sign +1; favorable wick is lower wick; close location is close_location
direction_normalization.SHORT: direction sign -1; favorable wick is upper wick; close location is 1-close_location
direction_normalization.absolute_channels: range, volume, spread and ATR percentile are not sign-flipped

context: Append the unchanged V3 causal M5/M15/H1/H4/D1 context vector available at decision_time.

training.overlap_weight: divide by the number of same-sleeve training decisions in the same 30-minute bucket
training.purged_oof: three expanding 2023 folds with six-hour purge, unchanged from V3

model_grid.classifier: LGBMClassifier 350 trees learning_rate 0.025 leaves 15 min_child 100 L2 5
CatBoostClassifier 300 iterations depth 5 learning_rate 0.03 L2 7 random_strength 1
